newsitem.title: UK: MSCI developing growth and value indices.
newsitem.headline: MSCI developing growth and value indices.

text.p: Development work is underway to create Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) value and growth indices, the calculator of the MSCI indices said on Friday.
Geneva-based Capital International Perspective said the new indices would use price/book value ratios to divide the current MSCI indices into two sub-indices - value and growth.
They will cover the full range of developed, emerging and all-country indices.
Full details would be announced in coming months, it said.
It said the price/book value ratios were the simplest and most consistent statistical measure to differentiate securities between value and growth across countries.
